title: fix(ui): list each failed validation rule as its own line in the form banner and toast

domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzC6RxMfB59EsgAoNN

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao1RUqxpYW3tyxDQLmPkuSfY)_

Fixes #28053

Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/react gains the public export unmarkedRefusalLines; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一次保存同时违反两条及以上校验规则时，表单横幅和 toast 改为每条规则一行；规则点名了表单上画出的字段时，消息留在该字段下，横幅只列其余的。
- 为什么改：以前横幅显示服务端用 `; ` 拼起来的一句话，用户读成一句长句，往往只改第一处；HotCRM 为此把两条预测规则改成互斥来绕开。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台的展示，服务端拒绝信封不变（实测本就逐条规则带 `fields[]`）；单条规则的拒绝在表单渲染器上不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts` 的 `unmarkedRefusalLines`、`form.tsx` 提交 catch 里的 `shownInline`、`FormPage.tsx` 提交 catch。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-refusal-lines-28053.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The server already says each failed rule separately: `ValidationError` keeps one `fields[]` entry per rule, located on the field the rule names, else on `_record`; only its top-level message is the `; `-join. The console threw the entries away whenever one of them had no drawn input and showed the joined text instead. Now:

- **`@object-ui/react`** adds `unmarkedRefusalLines(err, isShownInline)`: one line per `fields[]` entry the caller could not show under a visible input, in server order. It answers `null` (the caller keeps the envelope's message) when the refusal has no entry list, or when an entry it would have to say carries no human-readable `message`; it answers `[]` when every entry is inline. It reads the same three shapes `extractFieldErrors` reads (the adapter's `validationErrors`, the client's `details.fields`, a bare `fields`), now through one private `fieldEntries` reader.
- **Form renderer** (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`): the submit catch records which rejected fields it wrote under a DRAWN input (`fieldWrapper`), and the banner and toast say only the other entries, one list item each. One remaining entry stays a plain string, so a single-rule refusal reads exactly as before. The permission, delegated-scope and author-marked `userMessage` paths keep their precedence.
- **FormPage** (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`): the same rule over the rows it marks. Its banner and toast used to show `Submit failed (400): ` plus the raw response body for every server refusal; a refusal with entries no row carries now shows those entries' messages instead. A refusal whose every entry is marked on a row, or that has no entry list, still shows what it showed before.

Both surfaces draw several lines as a `ul` of `li`, in the banner and in the toast. No server, spec or envelope change.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.unmarked-refusal-lines.test.ts` (new, 8 cases): the measured two-rule body; located entry left out; all inline gives `[]`; two `_record` rules give two lines; adapter, client and hand-rolled shapes agree; an entry with no field is said; an entry with no message gives `null`; no entry list gives `null`.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-refusal-lines-28053.test.tsx` (new): two record-level rules give two banner items and two toast items and no `; `; one located plus one record-level rule gives the inline mark and one banner line; a single record-level rule is unchanged (the toast gets the plain string).
- `form-server-field-errors.test.tsx`: the case for a rejected field the form does not render now asserts the toast says only that field's reason (it asserted a substring of the joined text).
- `FormPage.refusalMarks-27417.test.tsx`: two `#28053` cases (two `_record` rules; one row-marked plus one record-level rule), and the undrawn-field case now asserts the banner says the reason and no row carries it (it asserted the reason appeared nowhere, which was the defect).

**Reverse verification.** With both submit catches restored to the base (`git restore --source=6410029d` of `form.tsx` and `FormPage.tsx`, helper kept), 6 of the 22 cases in the three consumer files went red (the four new consumer cases and the two updated ones); the single-rule case stayed green, as it should. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, proven by `git diff HEAD` empty and both blob hashes equal to `HEAD`'s.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise measured on the wire, not only the evaluator.** On `origin/main` `6410029d`, `POST /api/v1/data/:object` through `RestServer` over a real `ObjectQL` and an SQLite `SqlDriver` (a throwaway probe in `packages/rest`, not committed), with three `cross_field` rules:
  - one rule naming `best` plus one naming no field answered `400` with `error` = the `; `-join and `fields` = `[{field: best, code: rule_violation, message: …}, {field: _record, code: rule_violation, message: …}]`;
  - two rules naming no field answered two `_record` entries, each with its own message.
  So this is not a Seam; the ui lane fixes it.
- **FormPage single-entry change is deliberate.** A refusal with exactly one entry no row carries used to show `Submit failed (400): ` plus the raw JSON body; it now shows that entry's message. Same rule as the multi-entry case.
- An entry with no human-readable `message` falls back to the envelope's top-level text for the whole banner rather than putting an untranslated code on a line by itself.
- Not changed here: FormPage's banner and toast for a server refusal with no `fields[]` list, or whose every entry is marked on a row, still show `Submit failed (STATUS): ` plus the raw response body. Noted, not filed.
- Out of bounds and untouched: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, `providers/writeWarningToast.ts`, `views/RecordFormPage.tsx` (held by #27999).
